title: Harvard Holds 3.04 Million Bitcoin ETF Shares Steady
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Harvard Holds 3.04 Million Bitcoin ETF Shares Steady

Harvard Management Company's latest 13F shows it still holds 3,044,612 shares of BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust, unchanged since March, a stake now worth about $110.6 million after bitcoin's slide.

This post Harvard Holds 3.04 Million Bitcoin ETF Shares Steady first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Supreme Court Ends Custodia Bank’s Fight for a Fed Master Account, Leaving the Fed Free to Deny Crypto Banks Access
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Supreme Court Ends Custodia Bank’s Fight for a Fed Master Account, Leaving the Fed Free to Deny Crypto Banks Access

The Supreme Court denied Custodia Bank's petition in No. 26-62 on Monday, leaving in place a Tenth Circuit ruling that Federal Reserve Banks may reject even eligible applicants for master accounts.

This post Supreme Court Ends Custodia Bank’s Fight for a Fed Master Account, Leaving the Fed Free to Deny Crypto Banks Access first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Hong Kong to License Crypto Dealers and Custodians by Year-End
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Hong Kong to License Crypto Dealers and Custodians by Year-End

Financial Secretary Paul Chan said Hong Kong will introduce a bill by year-end to license crypto dealers, advisers, managers and custodians, after only two of 36 first-round stablecoin applicants received licenses in April.

This post Hong Kong to License Crypto Dealers and Custodians by Year-End first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Sweden’s H100 Taps Coinbase Prime and Deribit for Its 3,506 Bitcoin Treasury as It Courts Family Offices
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Sweden’s H100 Taps Coinbase Prime and Deribit for Its 3,506 Bitcoin Treasury as It Courts Family Offices

H100 Group will use Coinbase Prime and Deribit for custody, trading and financing of its roughly 3,506 BTC, worth about $226 million, as it builds bitcoin services for family offices and wealthy investors.

This post Sweden’s H100 Taps Coinbase Prime and Deribit for Its 3,506 Bitcoin Treasury as It Courts Family Offices first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Strive (ASST) Buys 251 Bitcoin for $17.5 Million as Shares Drop 10% Premarket

Strive (ASST) Buys 251 Bitcoin for $17.5 Million as Shares Drop 10% Premarket

Strive bought 251 bitcoin last week for $17.5 million at a $69,853 average, lifting holdings to 43,404 BTC, as shares dropped 9.5% premarket after bitcoin's weekend slide.

title: Bitcoin Price Trades Near $64,000 After Weekend Plunge to $62,000

Bitcoin Price Trades Near $64,000 After Weekend Plunge to $62,000

Bitcoin price traded near $64,000 on Monday morning after plunging to $62,000 over the weekend, as Nasdaq futures slid ahead of Nvidia's earnings and traders braced for a December Fed hike.

This post Bitcoin Price Trades Near $64,000 After Weekend Plunge to $62,000 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
